items.stem: Define the term 'initiation stage'.
items.answer: The first stage of a project, in which the problem or opportunity is identified, aims and feasibility are agreed and a project manager is appointed.

items.stem: Explain why a project must be planned before work starts.
items.answer: Planning identifies tasks, their order, durations and resources, so a realistic deadline and budget can be set and problems anticipated.

items.stem: Explain the purpose of a project review at the closure stage.
items.answer: It evaluates whether the aims were met on time and within budget and records lessons learned so future projects can avoid the same problems.
